original_ai_output.title_zh: 拉各斯大学国际学校员工抗议，教学与考试受扰
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚拉各斯大学国际学校员工于周三举行抗议，据称其姓名被从大学工资单中移除，且法院有利判决未获执行。抗议者聚集在校门口，要求恢复工资单登记并支付拖欠津贴。期中考试未能举行，教学活动暂停。目前信息来自单一来源。

location.site: 拉各斯大学国际学校正门
location.raw_text: International School, University of Lagos, school's main gate

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯大学国际学校员工周三举行抗议
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Staff of the International School, University of Lagos, protested the alleged removal of their names from the university’s payroll

key_facts.fact: 员工据称被从大学工资单中移除，且法院有利判决未获执行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: protested the alleged removal of their names from the university’s payroll and the failure to implement a court judgment in their favour

key_facts.fact: 抗议者聚集在校门口，要求恢复工资单登记并支付拖欠津贴
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: gathered at the school’s main gate, chanting solidarity songs while demanding the restoration of their names to the payroll and payment of outstanding allowances

key_facts.fact: 期中考试未举行，教学活动暂停
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the workers said the mid-term examination was not conducted, and teaching activities were suspended

uncertainties: 员工被移出工资单及法院判决未执行属据称，尚未获独立证实
